חובשים ופרמדיקים של מד'א העניקו טיפול רפואי ופינו לבית החולים רמב'ם 4 פצועים במצב קל עם סימני שאיפת עשן, בהם: גבר ואישה בשנות ה-40 ו-2 ילדות בנות 5
דווח על אישה שנחבלה בדרכה למרחב המוגן ואיבדה את הכרתה בבניין בתל אביב. חובשים ופרמדיקים של מד'א העניקו טיפול רפואי ופינו לבי'ח איכילוב אישה כבת 90 במצב קשה, מחוסרת הכרה עם חבלת ראש
הותרו לפרסום שמותיהם של ארבעת ההרוגים שחולצו מהריסות המבנה שנפגע מטיל איראני בחיפה: בני הזוג ולדמיר ולנה גרשביץ, כבני 80, בנם דימטרי גרשביץ בן ה-40 ובת זוגו לוסיל-ג'ין בת ה-30
חובש מד'א עידו אדלהייט: 'ראינו אישה בשנות ה-90 לחייה שוכבת בסמוך לגרם המדרגות כשהיא מחוסרת הכרה וסובלת מחבלה קשה בראשה, לאחר שנפלה ונחבלה בדרכה למרחב המוגן'
אחרי שעות ארוכות של חיפושים בזירת הפגיעה הקשה בחיפה, אותרו הבוקר שני בני אדם ללא רוח חיים מתחת להריסות הבניין שנפגע מטיל איראני
מפקד תחנת הכבאות בחיפה, טפסר משנה קובי מזרחי: 'זו הזירה הקשה ביותר בגזרת המחוז עד כה, גם מבחינת היקף ההרס, המורכבות והנפגעים'

نجمة داود الحمراء: طواقمها قدمت خلال الساعات الأربع والعشرين الماضية العلاج لـ56 شخصًا، بينهم 44 مصابًا جسديًا و12 مصابًا بحالات هلع. ارتفع عدد الذين تلقوا العلاج منذ بدء عملية 'زئير الأسد' إلى 2390 شخصًا
Ministry of Education announced that April 9-10 classes will continue in remote mode, pending no changes in Home Front Command orders.
IDF Home Front Command maintained unchanged public guidelines through April 7 at 14:00 following situation assessment.
At least 15 impact sites recorded in central Israel including Tel Aviv area from Iranian missile strike, with seriously wounded reported.
Magen David Adom: 34-year-old woman hit by fragments in Petah Tikva in serious condition; man in his 30s lightly hurt by glass shards in Tel Aviv.
Health Ministry: 163 injured in past 24 hours from Iran and Hezbollah attacks; 1 in serious condition, 4 moderate, 153 good condition. Some injuries indirect (while reaching shelters).
Health Ministry: Five people treated for anxiety in hospitals over past 24 hours.
Schools set to reopen after Passover under wartime guidelines: yellow zones allow in-person with shelter access; orange zones prohibit educational activities.
Home Front Command extended siren warning times for dozens of northern communities, increasing shelter-reach time from immediate/15-30 seconds to slightly longer periods.
Wartime restrictions on gatherings extended: educational activities prohibited in most of country; gatherings limited to 50 people with shelter access.

Prime Minister Netanyahu approved Education Ministry plan for partial school reopening Sunday: rotating system with 30-50% students in-person in lower-risk areas; studies in shelters in high-risk areas.
IDF Home Front Command Chief Maj.-Gen. Shay Klepper announced extension of siren warning times for Hezbollah rockets in northern communities, effective noon Tuesday.
Prime Minister Netanyahu announced schools for ages 0-8 set to gradually reopen Sunday pending local authority approval, with Education Minister Yoav Kisch stating outline ensures student safety.

Hospital patient: 'You look down and see a parking lot...It's truly horrific...The air was suffocating, with almost no circulation. All the wards were crammed into one another. We were worried our son would catch some kind of infection.'
Hospital patient: nurse said 'we should wear a mask and that there was no alternative' to crowded underground ward conditions.
After five-hour lull, sirens sounded in central Israel and West Bank; cluster munition strike reported with multiple impact sites and scattered damage across central Israel.

Family friend Lilach Levin: 'Dima managed to bring Vladimir home from the hospital, and then the missile hit the building and all four were killed. All the floors collapsed onto the ground floor where they lived.'
Faresah Habaka, aunt of killed tank battalion commander: 'We look at the pictures and it gives us the desire to come to work, by God.' Druze women sewing for IDF soldiers despite personal losses.
Sister L., 18, after brother's death in Gaza: 'I know there will be hard moments, but that's where I need to be' — enlisting in his combat engineering corps.
Multiple foreign airlines extending flight cancellations: Delta through Sept 5, Lufthansa Group through May 31, Wizz Air through April 20, LOT through May 31.
Haifa Mayor Yona Yahav: 'All city services are operating at the scene with full force, in close cooperation with the Home Front Command and the security and rescue forces.'
MDA EMT Ido Edelheit: elderly woman in her 90s found unconscious with severe head injury after falling while heading to shelter during siren.
Four missing persons believed trapped under rubble in Haifa after direct Iranian missile hit: elderly couple, son (~40), and caregiver.
Fire and Rescue Services deployed 'Lehava' national special rescue unit, Israel Electric Corporation teams, and heavy cranes for Haifa rescue operation.
Ministry of Defense recognized Maj. (Res.) Assaf Dagan as fallen soldier after proving moral injury and PTSD from two-decade military service led to his death.
Multiple interceptors launched at Haifa missile but all missed target; warhead did not detonate, limiting damage but complicating rescue operations.
34-year-old woman injured by cluster missile warhead in Petah Tikva; man ~30 lightly injured in Tel Aviv; heavy property damage in Ramat Gan, Bnei Brak, Kiryat Ono, and school building in Tel Aviv.
Education Minister Yoav Kisch announced remote learning continues through week's end after Passover, pending no change in Home Front Command guidelines.
Defense Minister Katz: 'Accelerating the production of Arrow interceptors on a large scale is already significantly increasing the number of interceptors produced each month.'
MDA paramedic Inbar Green: 44-year-old man moderately injured by blast wave from Iranian cluster missile in Ramat Gan; heavy damage to apartment on third floor of residential building.
MDA paramedic Muhammad Hazem: woman in her 50s fell approximately 4 meters into ditch while searching for shelter on Highway 20; evacuated with lower limb injuries.
Prime Minister Netanyahu: 'for those who follow the instructions of the Home Front Command and remain in a protected area, the chances of getting hurt are virtually non-existent.'
Four people confirmed dead in Haifa missile strike: Lena Ostrovsky (vocal coach), family members. Bodies recovered from rubble; four did not reach building shelter.

Home Front Command Chief Maj. Gen. Shay Klapper: 'Changing the defense warning times reflects the utmost importance we place on preserving human life...Extending warning times will allow residents to prepare more effectively during emergencies.'

Prime Minister Netanyahu approved Education Ministry proposal for gradual return to schools and kindergartens in small isolated groups ('capsules') starting Sunday, subject to Home Front Command approval.
